#MSNews | Firefighters rushed to extinguish the fire at 6th floor office of Alorica, located at the Three E-Com Center, Mall of Asia complex in Pasay City.

According to the Bureau of Fire Protection, the fire was first reported at around 9:58pm of December 21, Sunday.

The BFP, at 10:22pm raised the fire to 1st alarm and at 11:16pm, it was declared fire under control. | via Vince Lopez

📸: Filipino-Chinese Libertad Volunteer Fire Rescue, Inc.

👉 For the latest news, visit https://t.co/rmQCnNSOvI
